rejectedSources.prompt:
Create five ORIGINAL spectacular historical 2D RTS TOWN CENTER sprites on one production atlas. Highly realistic miniature 3D-rendered masonry, beautiful tile roofs, timber, fine stone carving, natural upper-left daylight. Clean TRUE ALPHA transparent cutouts; no backdrop, labels, scenery, people, animals or watermarks. The canvas is 1536x1024 landscape, a precise THREE COLUMN by TWO ROW layout of square 512x512 cells. Five separate compounds; sixth bottom-right cell COMPLETELY EMPTY AND TRANSPARENT. Order: top-left ROMAN, top-middle MONGOL, top-right PERSIAN; bottom-left TANG CHINESE, bottom-middle OTTOMAN.
Critical orthographic camera: equal left and right views, canonical ground edges slope exactly +1/2 and -1/2, vertical columns perfectly upright. Every compound stands on a single thin SQUARE foundation, a symmetrical exact 2:1 diamond; left/right corners equal y, front/back tips vertically aligned at pad center x, no rectangular perspective bases. The pad must be the whole compound boundary, so all enclosing walls, corner towers, wings and architectural props sit fully INSIDE the diamond. One detached compound per cell, safely below 82% width and height; large transparent gutters. No extra flags, because a separately drawn faction banner will be placed beside it. All roofs, walls, steps fully within cell. No tall foundations, no giant staircase hanging beyond front corner.
Civilization architecture: ROMAN warm ivory limestone and classical columns, red terracotta roofs, disciplined square courtyard. MONGOL ivory felt yurts with dark timber structures and cobalt decoration, dignified capital compound in historically plausible nomad timber-and-stone form; no enormous domed Persian palace. PERSIAN cream sandstone, warm adobe, turquoise blue glazed ornaments, elegant columned halls, carved winged lion gateposts. TANG CHINESE cream plaster and red timber, gray curved tiled roofs with upturned eaves, ordered courtyard architecture. OTTOMAN warm limestone and plaster, orange tile roofs, teal domes, arcaded square courtyard, restrained Ottoman ornament. Photorealistic fine material detail, earthy restrained colors and clean silhouette, sophisticated historical miniature game art; not painterly blur, not vectors.
All five sprites are AGE II organized provincial town centers, a visibly WIDER ENCLOSING COMPLEX around the main hall. The square ground pad encloses a low perimeter wall on all four edges, a real roofed entrance on the FRONT-RIGHT edge, main hall at back-center, TWO small side wings or service buildings, an open paved courtyard in middle. Roman colonnaded redtile civic hall, plaster/redtile sidewings, limestone lowwall; Mongol main large ger, secondary small felt gers, timber gate and timber/palisade enclosure; Persian cream stone columned hall with turquoise glazed trim, adobe-and-stone sidewings and carved stone courtyard gate; Tang two roofed wings flanking a Chinese main hall, redwood graytiles, cream perimeterwall and tiledgateway; Ottoman medium teal dome civic hall with orange-tile side wings, arcaded entry, low masonry perimeter. Architecture and materials substantially stronger than early crude frontier hall, but still smaller and less majestic than imperial capital. Do not depict one solitary tall building, depict the whole enclosed courtyard compound. Camera perfect square 2:1 diamond as specified.
